title: Nuh and the ark
hook: They mocked him as he built the ark

phrases.text: Every time they passed by, they mocked him… as he built the ark.
Prophet Nuh, peace be upon him, called his people to Allah for nine hundred and fifty years.
phrases.say: Prophet Nuh, peace be upon him, called his people to Allah for nine hundred and fifty years.

phrases.text: Only a few believed. And Allah told him: build the ark under Our eyes.
Then rain poured from the sky, and springs burst from the earth.
The ark sailed through waves like mountains.
At last, it came to rest on Mount Judi.
